title: Divergence of the tilt test field ζ²·p_S^⊥(x − ξ)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let T, S be linear subspaces of ℝ^P with orthogonal projections p_T, p_S, let ξ, x ∈ ℝ^P, and let ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ be differentiable at x. Put X(y) := ζ(y)²·((y − ξ) − p_S(y − ξ)). Then trace(p_T ∘ DX(x)) = ζ(x)²·trace(p_T ∘ (I − p_S)) + 2ζ(x)·Dζ(x)[p_T((x − ξ) − p_S(x − ξ))], where DX(x) = fderiv ℝ X x and Dζ(x) = fderiv ℝ ζ x. For T = T_xM = approxTangentPlane n M x the left side is tangentialDivergence n M X x = div_M X(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (T S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ) (ξ x : Euclid P), DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (T.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => ζ y ^ 2 • ((y - ξ) - S.starProjection (y - ξ))) x).toLinearMap) = ζ x ^ 2 * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (T.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Euclid P) - S.starProjection).toLinearMap) + 2 * ζ x * fderiv ℝ ζ x (T.starProjection ((x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)))
